name: PageBoxes
summary: Webflow's Boxes (LR156, DesignUp): each Box drawn as its `tag` (div by default) with `data-box` (its styles' handle) and its `anchor` as its `id`, holding its Boxes and entries in order; an entry is drawn by the page (`renderEntry`) in a `div` with `data-box-entry`. No element of its own around the list, so it sits in a PageGrid cell or any container as its children. The look is the Boxes' own layout values, from `PageBoxStyles`, once per page, and a Box's page look (`look` band, tint or lead, + `trail`; LR162) drawn as `data-look` with the page grid's settings (`--c-page-grid-frame-*`, `--c-page-grid-lead-*`), so a page needs no PageGrid. Model and check: `@design-library/core/page-box`. Not for a block's inner layout (blocks are sealed presets) or an app's regions (use AppLayout or EditorLayout).
a11y: Plain elements: a `div` has no role; a Box given a landmark tag (section, nav, aside, header, footer, main) is that landmark, so name it from its content. Reading order is the source order at every width; `order` and grid placement in styles move boxes visually only, so keep reading order and visual order the same.
